rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for acting in a generally firm, strong, or resolute manner.

example.english: I firmly said, “I won’t change my mind.”
example.traditional: 我堅定咁話：「我唔會改變主意。」
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin1 ding6 gam2 waa6 ngo5 m4 wui5 goi2 bin3 zyu2 ji3

rows.note: Use this for a definite, unequivocal, or decisive manner, especially when correcting or rejecting something firmly.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zaam2 deng1 zit6 tit3 gam2 waa6 m4 dak1

rows.note: Use this verb-plus-complement construction when something is fastened or secured so it will not come loose.

example.english: I tied the rope firmly, so there’s no need to worry it will come loose.
example.traditional: 我將條繩綁實，唔使驚佢會鬆。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 tiu4 sing4 bong2 sat6 m4 sai2 geng1 keoi5 wui5 sung1

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that something is held, tied, or gripped tightly rather than merely securely fastened.

example.english: You need to hold the handrail firmly.
example.traditional: 你要緊緊咁揸住條扶手。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 gan2 gan2 gam2 zaa1 zyu6 tiu4 fu4 sau2
